common.disclaimer: ClaimProof is not an official insurer or government service. Always inform your insurer through official channels.

auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.consentText: ClaimProof prepares evidence for your own use. We store your incident details, photos, and location to generate your evidence pack. We do not store bank account or Aadhaar numbers. Photos may be analyzed by AI (Google Gemini) to provide quality feedback. You can delete your data anytime.
auth.consentCheckbox: I understand and agree to the above
auth.loginFailed: Login failed. Check your email and password.
auth.signupFailed: Sign up failed. Please try again.
auth.signupSuccess: Account created! Check your email to confirm.

deadline.expired: The 72-hour window may have passed. Late reports can be rejected, but contact your insurer, bank or agriculture office as soon as possible — and keep collecting evidence.
deadline.rulesNote: Rules can differ for your scheme or insurer. Treat this as the latest safe time and confirm with your insurer.

intimation.title: Official Intimation
intimation.stepADescription: Call 14447, use the Crop Insurance App, or contact your insurer, bank or agriculture office. Then record it here.
intimation.guidance: Keep ready: survey number, crop, affected area, and your enrollment number or bank-account details (enter these only on the official channel; ClaimProof does not store bank or Aadhaar numbers).

dashboard.stepBDesc: Take clear photos of the damage — wide shots and close-ups.

dashboard.stepDDesc: Create your evidence pack PDF to share with your insurer.
